title: This Squid Throws Out 95% of Its Living Glow Every Morning
subject: bobtail squid

scenes.text: This squid throws away its light every morning.
The Hawaiian bobtail squid keeps glowing bacteria in a special organ underneath its body.
The glow matches the moonlight falling from above, which erases its shadow from predators looking up.
At dawn, it buries itself in sand and pushes out about ninety-five percent of the bacteria.
The few that remain multiply all day, and glow only once they're dense enough.
It doesn't just wear a light. It farms one, every single day.

description:
The Hawaiian bobtail squid hides its shadow with glowing bacteria, then vents about 95 percent of them every dawn.
The survivors regrow through the day and only glow once they're dense enough.
Would you rather be a squid with a night light or a squid with a camouflage cloak?
first_comment: If you could glow like this squid, would you use it to hide or to show off?
